say:2:1430247101:1.text: Yes, his commoner subordinate Indris just became the Captain of the Sal'thorin Guard.
say:2:1430247101:1.source_cn: 是的，他的手下因度厄，身为平民竟然成了卫队长。
say:2:1430247101:1.male: Yes, his commoner subordinate Indris just became the Captain of the Sal'thorin Guard.
say:2:1430247101:1.female: Yes, his commoner subordinate Indris just became the Captain of the Sal'thorin Guard.

say:3:1430247102:1.text: I heard that Lord Ravion likes to judge people by their appearance... This may be the reason why Indris was promoted.
say:3:1430247102:1.source_cn: 我听说沙利叶殿下很喜欢以貌取人……这或许是因度厄升迁的原因。

say:4:1430247103:1.text: By their appearance, huh? Well, Indris does have his merits there.
say:4:1430247103:1.source_cn: 以貌取人？从这方面来看，因度厄确实也有些可取之处。
